members.name: Arin
members.bio: The eldest. Promised Mother she would bring everyone home.

members.name: Bram
members.bio: Quiet and stubborn. Carries Father's old map.

members.name: Cora
members.bio: Reads every page of Father's journal twice.

members.name: Dain
members.bio: Too young to remember Father's face, old enough to follow his road.

members.name: Wren
members.bio: Travelled with Father three years ago and came back alone, remembering nothing past the Forest.

classless.name: Classless
classless.description: No special training yet. Can Attack, Defend and use Items.

swordsman.name: Swordsman
swordsman.description: Balanced and dependable. Strong melee strikes, solid health.

challenge.intro: An old man lowers his practice blade. "Land enough blows before I tire of you, and I will teach you the sword."
challenge.pass: The old man laughs and bows. "You have the spirit of the blade."
challenge.fail: The old man sheathes his sword. "Not yet. Come back when your arms are stronger."

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: The fastest of the Party. Shoots any enemy, even in the back row, and often lands critical hits.

challenge.intro: A veteran hunter strings her bow. "Hunters strike first and never miss twice. Show me you can keep up."
challenge.pass: She lowers her bow with a grin. "Fast hands. Take this bow, it has waited for someone like you."
challenge.fail: "Too slow. The forest does not wait for anyone."

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Fragile but devastating. Magic ignores armour and Fireball strikes every enemy at once.

challenge.intro: Blue fire gathers into a figure between the pillars. "Words of power answer only to a steady mind. Prove yours."
challenge.pass: The flames bow low. "The old words are yours now. Use them gently."
challenge.fail: The fire gutters out. "Your mind wanders. Return when it is still."

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: The Party's shield. The most HP and Defense of any Class; protects allies and blunts incoming damage.

challenge.intro: The stone knight raises its shield. "None pass who cannot stand firm. Strike me, and endure my answer."
challenge.pass: The sentinel kneels and offers its shield. "Stand before those you love. That is the Guardian's oath."
challenge.fail: The sentinel does not move. "You are not yet a wall. Return when you are."

combat.name: Follow the Stream
combat.hint: Fresh tracks in the mud. Something hunts along the water.

combat.name: Dark Thicket
combat.hint: Branches rustle where there is no wind.

combat.name: Wolf Trail
combat.hint: Howling close by. A fight is certain.

combat.name: Overgrown Road
combat.hint: Arrows stuck in the trees. Someone guards this road.

merchant.name: Travelling Merchant
merchant.hint: A cart with a lantern. Gold can buy help here.

merchant.name: Trapper's Stall
merchant.hint: Herbs and tonics traded for coin.

rest.name: Quiet Glade
rest.hint: Soft moss and clean water. A place to recover.

rest.name: Hollow Oak
rest.hint: A dry shelter inside a giant tree.

treasure.name: Abandoned Cabin
treasure.hint: Nobody has lived here for years. Maybe something was left behind.

treasure.name: Fallen Cart
treasure.hint: An overturned cart half-buried in leaves.

story.name: Old Campfire
story.hint: Cold ashes and a familiar knot in the rope. Was Father here?

story.name: Carved Stone
story.hint: Marks cut into a stone by a careful hand.

story.name: Ranger's Hut
story.hint: Someone who remembers travellers lives here.

story.name: Hollow Tree
story.hint: Something is tucked deep inside a lightning-split tree.

class.name: Old Swordsman's Hut
class.hint: An old man practises forms outside his hut.

class.name: Hunter Camp
class.hint: Hunters test newcomers with bow and blade.

class.name: Ruined Shrine
class.hint: Blue fire flickers between the broken pillars.

class.name: Stone Sentinel
class.hint: A moss-covered knight of stone blocks the path.

spirit_bloom.name: Spirit Bloom
spirit_bloom.description: Revives a fallen ally with 40% HP.

firebomb.name: Firebomb
firebomb.description: Deals 18 fire damage to every enemy.

grey_wolf.name: Grey Wolf
grey_wolf.description: Fast and relentless. Always goes for whoever is weakest.

thornback_boar.name: Thornback Boar
thornback_boar.description: Slow and armoured. Charges whoever looks the strongest. Fears fire.

bramble_archer.name: Bramble Archer
bramble_archer.description: Shoots from the back row at anyone in sight. Melee cannot reach it while the front row stands.

forest_wisp.name: Forest Wisp
forest_wisp.description: Mends wounded allies. Hurls spirit fire when nobody needs healing.

old_swordsman.name: Old Swordsman
old_swordsman.description: A retired blade master testing your resolve. He will not truly hurt you.

veteran_hunter.name: Veteran Hunter
veteran_hunter.description: A seasoned hunter testing your speed. Her blunt arrows sting but will not truly hurt you.

shrine_spirit.name: Shrine Spirit
shrine_spirit.description: An old guardian flame. It tests the mind, not the body, and will not truly hurt you.

stone_sentinel.name: Stone Sentinel
stone_sentinel.description: A living statue testing your endurance. Its blows are heavy but will not truly hurt you.

elder_thornwarden.name: Elder Thornwarden
elder_thornwarden.description: The Guardian of the Forest: ancient bark and thorn. Watch for its warnings; its heaviest blows come one turn later.

merchant.greeting: "Herbs, tonics, a little fire in a jar. Coin first, friends."

rest.text: The Party rests. Wounds are cleaned and bandaged.

treasure.text: Among the dust and leaves, something useful catches the light.

power_slash.name: Power Slash
power_slash.description: A heavy melee strike dealing 180% ATK damage to one enemy. Cooldown: 2 turns.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.description: A careful ranged shot at 140% ATK that always lands a critical hit. Reaches the back row. Cooldown: 2 turns.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Fire magic at 110% MAG that hits every enemy, front and back row. Burns enemies weak to fire harder. Cooldown: 2 turns.

frost_lance.name: Frost Lance
frost_lance.description: An ice spear at 160% MAG against one enemy anywhere on the field. Cooldown: 1 turn.

protect.name: Protect
protect.description: Guard one ally until your next turn: attacks aimed at them hit you instead, with 30% less damage.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.description: Raise your shield for everyone: the whole Party takes 40% less damage until your next turn. Cooldown: 3 turns.

old_campfire.title: The Old Campfire
old_campfire.text: A ring of blackened stones sits under a pine. The rope still tied to a branch uses Father's double knot, the one he taught all of you. Two bedrolls were pressed into the moss here long ago.

choices.label: Search the ashes
choices.hint: Look for anything he left behind.

outcome.text: Under the ashes lies a scorched page from Father's journal: 'West along the stream. W. keeps up better than I do.'

choices.label: Rest by the old fire
choices.hint: Take a moment to recover here.

outcome.text: You rekindle the fire and rest where Father once rested. Tucked under a stone you find his tin cup, engraved with Mother's name.

carved_stone.title: The Carved Stone
carved_stone.text: Deep marks are cut into a standing stone: a wave, a lighthouse, and a cup drawn upside down. Beneath them, a single letter: E. Father's initial.

outcome.text: Father marked the way west: past the sea, past the last lighthouse. But why would he draw the Chalice upside down?

ranger_hut.title: The Ranger's Hut
ranger_hut.text: An old ranger squints at the Party, then at Wren. "You. You were with him, the man with the map. Three winters ago. You were half dead when you came back through here." Wren has no memory of it.

outcome.text: "He asked about the Guardian of the Forest. Said he had to get past it, whatever it cost. I never saw him come back."
"You were carrying his journal, lad, and shaking. You kept saying: it asks for a life. Then you slept for three days."

hollow_tree.title: The Hollow Tree
hollow_tree.text: Inside a lightning-split oak, wrapped in oilcloth, is a letter addressed to Mother in Father's hand. It was never sent.

outcome.text: 'If the Chalice asks a price, I will pay it. Not you. Not the children. Never the children.'

journal_page.title: Scorched Journal Page
journal_page.text: Father followed the stream west with a companion he called 'W.'

tin_cup.title: Father's Tin Cup
tin_cup.text: Engraved with Mother's name. He carried it the whole way.

carved_map.title: The Carved Stone
carved_map.text: A wave, a lighthouse and an upside-down cup: the road leads past the last lighthouse, beyond the sea.

ranger_account.title: The Ranger's Account
ranger_account.text: Father meant to get past the Guardian of the Forest, whatever it cost.

wren_return.title: Wren's Return
wren_return.text: Wren came back half dead, carrying Father's journal and repeating: 'It asks for a life.'

unsent_letter.title: The Unsent Letter
unsent_letter.text: Father was ready to pay the Chalice's price himself: 'Never the children.'

wolf_collar.title: Traveller's Token
wolf_collar.text: A brass token from the western port, found among the wolves' leavings. Father bought passage there once.

torn_cloak.title: Torn Grey Cloak
torn_cloak.text: A scrap of Father's grey cloak caught on thorns, heading deeper into the Forest.

guardian_mark.title: Claw-Marked Shield
guardian_mark.text: A traveller's shield scored by huge claws. The Guardian has stopped others before you.

boss.name: Elder Thornwarden
boss.title: Guardian of the Forest
boss.intro: The trees part. A figure of bark and thorn rises, taller than the pines, eyes glowing green. "Many have come seeking the sea. Few have passed. None have returned."

phases.name: Wrathful Bloom
phases.text: The Thornwarden roars. Its bark splits and blood-red blossoms burst open. It moves faster now!

phases.name: Heartwood Fury
phases.text: Its glowing heart is laid bare. The Thornwarden fights with everything it has left!

crushing_root.name: Crushing Root
crushing_root.telegraph: Roots coil beneath {target}. Something huge is coming next turn!

thorn_storm.name: Thorn Storm
thorn_storm.telegraph: Thorns rise around the whole Party. Brace yourselves before its next turn!

victory.title: The Forest Falls Silent
victory.text: The Thornwarden sinks to its knees and becomes an old tree once more. In the roots lies a rusted compass with Father's initials, still pointing west, toward the sea. Wren holds it and, for a moment, remembers a voice: "Keep going. Don't wait for me." The road beyond the Forest is open.

defeat.title: Lost in the Forest
defeat.text: The Forest closes around the Party. Somewhere far away, Mother is still waiting. Gather your strength and try again.
